stages.title: Cache write path = the real data1.dat decoder
stages.summary: Full workspace rebuilt from a verified uptodown XAPK (all sha256 match); 55-function Ghidra decompile of the GNP/cache cluster; NTY format ground truth via Unicorn parse emulation (MM magic, 21 RES.DAT.00 volumes); decryptWriteCache 0x1f1c914 = the real decoder (class-bit decoders + gzip path); encrypted-NTY key-record mechanism (sigInstall 0x39dea94: 36-byte signature doubles as the 32-byte RC4-255 key, mode 0x40000000, crc-verified re-parse); M3c oracle bug found and fixed (it rejected the true 'MM' magic); 4 new key candidates discovered; corrected sweeps still negative => the data1.dat key is a runtime APU-table signature (capture point documented)

stages.title: Runtime key-capture toolchain (Frida) + completed offline data1.dat pipeline
stages.summary: Complete on-device -> offline toolchain for the data1.dat 32-byte signature: Frida agent resolves the libgame.so base + live 0x9d overlay (module offsets == libgame.so VAs, no signature scan) and hooks keyExpansion 0x39d39f4 / full builder 0x39d3a30 / sigInstall 0x39dea94 / NtyReader::open 0x39dda24, dumping keys + sig records + open paths + the sinatra tables (T1..T4@0x14f7375.., rounds@0x1464760) + optional strings-region/full-image dumps. Offline: m4_decrypt_data1.py reproduces sigInstall (custom-seed RC4-255 KSA, period-255 PRGA, crc32, corrected MM oracle, --sweep incl. the embedded-record hypothesis the M3d matrix never tried); existing m3d_emu_nty_full.py gained --json; m4_extract.py extracts volumes (raw + gzip + RC4-255). Synthetic round-trip selftest ALL PASS (MM/crc/byte-exact roundtrip/negative control/period-255). XAPK re-acquisition blocked (uptodown Turnstile / CF mirrors) — the agent's table+image dumps close that gap.
